localGuidance: Native Kotlin Android caller helper. ERP owns business data and SQL; Auth owns browser identity. Preserve PKCE, tenant scope, foreground/lock-screen boundaries and release signing identity. Read README.md. Commands: ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:lintDebug, npm test, npm run quality:check. Real-device and incoming-call acceptance is separate from automated tests.

README.md.purpose: Android app, server prerequisites, release and acceptance contract

app/src/test/java/ro/chimeraerp/assist/B.behavior: Reject altered issuer/tenant endpoints and missing, wrong or expired callback state
limitations: Pure Android boundary tests; no physical call or browser return acceptance

app/src/test/java/ro/chimeraerp/assist/E.behavior: Reject unsafe ERP origins and partner document paths
limitations: Pure Android boundary tests; no physical call or browser return acceptance

tool/release.test.mjs.behavior: Stable unambiguous Android versions, exact release package/certificate, hash/source-bound public download metadata
limitations: Synthetic badging/signature fixtures; actual APK independently checked before publication
